xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA band"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring large"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring small"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA content"><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA eyebrow"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA eyebrow rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA eyebrow text"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA eyebrow rule 2"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="CTA title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA body"></e-paragraph><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA buttons"><e-button configuration-id="CTA quote"></e-button><e-button configuration-id="CTA call"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

CTA title.title: Ready to elevate your guest experience?

CTA body.paragraph: Tell us about your venue and we will curate the right products, brands and quantities — from a single outlet to a full hotel opening.

style.CTA band: flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 560px; padding: 107px 100px; overflow: hidden; background-image: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.84) 0%, rgba(7,31,68,0.84) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/home-cta-bg.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-color: #071F44; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; min-height: 0px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; min-height: 0px; }
style.CTA ring large: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 50%; top: -100px; width: 760px; height: 760px; min-width: 760px; transform: translateX(-50%); border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.4);
style.CTA ring small: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 50%; top: 0px; width: 560px; height: 560px; min-width: 560px; transform: translateX(-50%); border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.4);
style.CTA content: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 26px; padding: 0px; max-width: 900px; z-index: 2;
style.CTA title: font-size: 68px; line-height: 70px; color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; max-width: 860px; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 52px; line-height: 56px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.CTA body: font-size: 17px; line-height: 29px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-align: center; max-width: 640px; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CTA buttons: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; }
